escalation_condition: Facial droop, arm weakness, slurred speech (BE-FAST), sudden seizure, or sudden severe confusion
source: AHA / ASA Stroke Recognition and Seizure First Aid
approved_actions: Perform the FAST check: Face droop? Arm weakness? Slurred speech? Record exact time symptoms began.
Help the patient lie down with head and shoulders slightly elevated on pillows.
For seizures: clear dangerous objects away, protect head with soft padding, and do not restrain movements.
Turn seizure patient onto their side into recovery position once convulsions stop to keep airway clear.
Stay with the person, speaking in calm, reassuring tones.
critical_actions: Note the exact time symptoms started.
Keep airway open and prevent secondary injury from falls.
contraindications: Never put anything into the mouth of a person having a seizure.
Do not give food, water, or aspirin.
